answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 9817 Country: India Title: Asalamoalaikum. Is it allowed to touch a prayer book containg one complete surah without wazu and read the surahs writen in it without wazu? Question: Asalamoalaikum. Is it allowed to touch a prayer book containg one complete surah without wazu and read the surahs writen in it without wazu? Answer ID: 9817 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2458/2096=H/1429) It is allowed to recite without wudhu , but the place of the surah printed in the book should be touched only in a state wudhu . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
